subject: Private Deployment - VPC/on-prem licensing & support tiers
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@acmetx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmetx.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private deployment pricing / VPC options

Marcus —

Thanks for the demo last week. We liked the dedicated/private deployment option for PCI/clinical data isolation, but need clarity on licensing and total cost of ownership. A couple of specific asks: 

- What is the breakdown between the platform fee vs. the on-prem license?
- Do you price per GPU / per node or do you do a flat site license?
- How do support tiers work (SLA, response times, included hours for upgrades/patching)?
- Any discounts for a 12–24 month committed contract and a two-site deployment?

Also can you share a sample SOW and an initial pricing workbook we can circulate to finance?

We’d prefer to keep the conversation focussed on commercial structure before legal redlines.

Best,
Emma Li
VP Engineering, Acme Therapeutics
[Attachment: Acme_NDA_signed.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@acmetx.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmetx.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing / VPC options

Thanks Emma — appreciate the clear list. High level answers below; I’ve attached a draft SOW and a workbook for line-item pricing. I’ll also loop in our solutions lead to confirm integrations (KMS, HSM, on-prem install).

Summary (top-line):
- Licensing: 2-part model: one-time on-prem license (per-site) + annual platform fee that covers control plane, updates, and console.
- Capacity: we offer optional per-GPU capacity buckets for burst/dedicated throughput; customers can choose site-flat license + GPU add-ons or per-GPU pricing if they prefer utility style billing.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 48h first response), Premium (24/7, 4h P1), Enterprise (SLA-backed, named TAM, quarterly on-site/remote reviews).
- Discounts: we typically offer 15–25% on list for 12–24m ELAs depending on committed spend and number of sites. For two-site deployments we treat each site as a licensed instance but will provide a multi-site pricing credit.

Attached: Redwood_Private_Pricing_SOW_v1.pdf, Pricing_Workbook.xlsx

Next steps: I’ll bring Marissa (presales) and Dev (SE) into the thread to confirm integration/installation assumptions and final pricing. If you can send the PO template, we’ll prepare an ELA draft.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing / VPC options

Looping internal folks for pricing confirmation — summary of what Acme needs and our suggested posture: 

- Base on-prem license: $120k/site one-time (includes installer, baseline integrations, KMS connector, up to 8 vGPU-equivalents).
- Platform fee: $40k/year/site (control plane, console, monitoring, updates).
- GPU capacity add-on: $10k per additional vGPU-equivalent / month (billed annually).
- Support: Standard included for first year; Premium = +$20k/year/site, Enterprise = +$60k/year/site (includes TAM).
- Installation & professional services: estimated $18k one-time for two-site deployment (discovery + install + validation).

Discounts: for a 12-month commit across both sites we can go to 20% off list (license + platform fee) assuming they purchase at least the base capacity. If finance wants a greater concession (≥25%), we need manager approval and an ARR commit / signed PO.

Questions to Dev: confirm the install scope and KMS/HSM notes for Acme (they mentioned on-prem HSM).

-Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing / VPC options

Marissa — confirmed. Technical constraints and notes for the SOW: 

- KMS/HSM: we support customer KMS via Cloud KMS connectors and can integrate with on-prem HSMs (PKCS#11). HSM integration requires a 2–3 day on-site windows for key provisioning and validation; include in PS.
- Capacity sizing: base license covers up to ~8 vGPU equivalent for typical LLM serving (short sequences). If Acme will run long-context generative workflows, recommend provisioning 12–16 vGPU-equivalent capacity.
- Upgrades: minor patches are pushed via control plane; major on-prem upgrades scheduled as part of PS with a 2-week window for validation (included in the install estimate or as separate labor).
- SOC2 / audit evidence: we can provide SOC2 Type II report for the control plane and a deployment checklist for on-prem that captures audit logs, retention config, and key handling.

If they want a 25% discount we need written approval from sales leadership (Lauren) because that approaches our discount cap for first-year ELAs.

-Dev

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing posture for Acme Therapeutics

Thanks team — approved up to 25% off list for the first-year invoice on a 12-month ELA provided: 
- They sign within 14 days and provide a PO referencing deal RDW-ACME-2026-048.
- Minimum committed spend = $150k (net after discount) across the two sites.
- Installation PS to be invoiced separately (standard practice).

Marcus — go back to Acme with the 25% conditional offer, include the SOW and pricing workbook, and ask for their PO template so legal/finance can draft the ELA.

-Lauren

Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing / VPC options

Emma / Oliver — thanks again for the thoughtful questions. We reviewed internally and can do the following for Acme Therapeutics: 

Offer summary (conditional):
- 1x on-prem site license per site: list $120k -> 25% discount = $90k/site (first-year one-time).
- Platform fee: list $40k/year/site -> 25% discount = $30k/year/site (first-year).
- GPU add-ons: unchanged list pricing (flexible to add later).
- Premium support (recommended for production): +$20k/year/site (can be added to the ELA).
- Installation / PS: estimated $18k one-time (invoiced separately).

Conditions: 12-month ELA, signed PO within 14 days, minimum net committed spend $150k across both sites. Once we have the PO we’ll circulate an ELA + SOW and provide SOC2 evidence and the on-prem deployment checklist.

Attached: Redwood_Private_Pricing_SOW_v1.pdf, Pricing_Workbook.xlsx

Next steps: Please send your PO template (or use the attached Acme_Tx_PO_Template.docx) and confirm whether you want Premium support included in the first-year invoice. If acceptable, I’ll have legal generate the ELA and Marissa/Dev will schedule discovery for install.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
